notes.content:

Take a look below at the videos and Steam Community posts to learn more about NORSE: Oath of Blood.


IGN Interview with NORSE Developers
For a deeper look into the game, watch the IGN Rewind Theater interview featuring NORSE: Oath of Blood developers Terje Lundberg (Creative Director) and Philip Stevens (Narrative Director).

notes.title: IGN Interview with NORSE Developers
notes.content:
IGN Live Rewind Theater


[img src="https://media.tripwirecdn.com/061825/ign_live_interview.png"]

Terje Lundberg (Creative Director) and Philip Stevens (Narrative Director) join IGN’s Alan Knight for an in-depth discussion about NORSE: Oath of Blood. Together, they dissect the newest trailer and delve into the game’s narrative and design elements.


[previewyoutube="TQQsL0qIaaU;full"][/previewyoutube]

Story Teaser Trailer
Here’s the full Story Teaser Trailer that premiered during IGN Live. It offers a glimpse into NORSE: Oath of Blood’s narrative and includes a few gameplay moments. More gameplay will be showcased in upcoming videos—so stay tuned! 
[previewyoutube="V24xJDzxxiU;full"][/previewyoutube]

May News Recap
Here are a few highlights from May that you might have missed.


Concept Art Showcase - Environments & Heroes of the North
[img src="https://media.tripwirecdn.com/051625/rakkr.jpg"]

Explore the newly released concept art for NORSE: Oath of Blood, showcasing a range of character classes, unique armor sets, and diverse environments.

Take a look at the concept art featured in this Steam Community post.


International Viking Day Trailer
In celebration of International Viking Day, we released a short teaser trailer for NORSE: Oath of Blood.
[previewyoutube="xGZn6jHZITg;full"][/previewyoutube]

How MetaHuman and UE5 are Powering NORSE
We're excited to share how Unreal Engine 5, especially MetaHuman, is helping us bring authenticity and emotional depth to NORSE: Oath of Blood through expressive characters and richly detailed environments. Tools like Nanite, Lumen, and MetaHuman have empowered our small team to achieve a level of visual and narrative quality that was once out of reach. 


Learn more in our full interview with Epic Games and in a video with our Creative Director, Terje Lundberg.


[previewyoutube="Z8m207DGvjU;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Celebrating International Viking Day!
notes.content:
On this International Viking Day, we honor the legacy of the Norse with something worthy of the sagas: the unveiling of our latest trailer and a new name - NORSE: Oath of Blood.

This trailer offers new peeks into the brutal violence, rich culture, and delicate diplomacy that define the Viking age in our upcoming turn-based tactical RPG. 

[previewyoutube=xGZn6jHZITg;full][/previewyoutube]

Set in the harsh, untamed wilderness of dark age Norway, NORSE: Oath of Blood puts players in the war-worn boots of Gunnar, a young warrior out to avenge the murder of his father, Jarl Gripr, at the hands of the traitor Steinarr Far-Spear. As Gunnar, you must rebuild your shattered clan, gather allies, and rise to reclaim what was taken.

But survival in this world demands more than vengeance.

Key Features:


Tactical Turn-Based Combat: Engage in brutal skirmishes where positioning and tactics are everything.

Settlement Building: Raise your village from a meager camp to a fortified stronghold.

Narrative-Driven Choices: Forge alliances, betray enemies, and shape Gunnar’s destiny through every decision.

Authentic Viking Storytelling: Written by Giles Kristian, Sunday Times bestselling author of Norse historical fiction, the game delivers an immersive, character-driven Viking epic.

Currently in development for Windows PC and consoles, NORSE: Oath of Blood is scheduled for release in 2025.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076955/44fc35e62f99b622bda0e762c1d39f8a1570309c.png

Raise a horn and join us in honoring the legacy of the Norse, the seafarers, warriors and storytellers whose sagas still echo through the fjords of history.

Skål!

– The Arctic Hazard & Tripwire Presents Teams

notes.title: NORSE: Oath of Blood is Coming!
notes.content:
NORSE: Oath of Blood is Coming
Hey everyone!

We’ve got some incredible news to share with you today – NORSE: Oath of Blood is officially being published by Tripwire Presents! We couldn't be more excited to finally tell you, and we want to bring you along for the ride as NORSE: Oath of Blood marches toward its 2025 launch.

Check out the announcement trailer if you have not already!
[previewyoutube=D5f5X7wtoVg;full][/previewyoutube]

Step Into Gunnar’s Saga
https://media.tripwirecdn.com/043025/blooddemandsbloodbption2.gif

In NORSE: Oath of Blood, you are Gunnar, a young warrior betrayed and cast aside by Steinarr Far-Spear, whose treachery robbed you of kin and honor alike. With blade in hand and vengeance burning in your heart, you must rise from the ashes of your shattered world, carving out a future through the mountains and fjords of Viking Age Norway.

It will not be enough merely to lead your warband into battle. You must also rebuild, gather loyal followers, forge alliances, and shape your destiny with every choice you make.

Tactical Combat, Viking-Style
https://media.tripwirecdn.com/043025/tacticalcombat.gif

If you love deep strategy and challenging battles, you’re going to feel right at home. NORSE: Oath of Blood blends classic turn-based tactics with authentic Viking culture, even incorporating "Glima," the traditional Norse martial art. Every decision you make, both on and off the battlefield, will have real consequences for Gunnar and his people.

And, because we know story matters just as much as combat, we’re thrilled to have Giles Kristian, bestselling author of the acclaimed Raven and Rise of Sigurd trilogies, helping craft the world and its characters. We can’t wait for you to immerse yourself in the saga he’s helped create.

Built by Veterans, For Fans Like You
https://media.tripwirecdn.com/043025/mocapstudiocropped.png

Our team at Arctic Hazard is made up of developers who’ve worked on games like Assassin’s Creed: Odyssey, Metro: Exodus, and Age of Conan – but NORSE: Oath of Blood is something special. It’s a game made by fans of Viking stories and tactical games, for fans who’ve been craving a gritty, true-to-spirit Viking adventure.

Wishlist Now and Join the Journey
https://media.tripwirecdn.com/043025/settlementandwarband.gif

NORSE: Oath of Blood is available to wishlist on Steam right now!

Wishlist NORSE: Oath of Blood on Steam

We’ll have a lot more to show you in the coming months – deeper looks at the combat, the world, the characters, and maybe even a few surprises we’re keeping under wraps.

Thank you for being part of this journey from the start. We’re building NORSE: Oath of Blood for you, and we can’t wait for you to take up Gunnar’s axe and write your own legend.

Skål!

 – The Arctic Hazard & Tripwire Presents Team
